review_method: Post-freeze, failure-oriented study of the SAME native I/51 1190x1764 original image after frozen first reading commit 2e597f33. Audited 20 prose rows and 18 historic Cyrillic titles over 20 source rows. After the source-only freeze, also checked secondary OCR at ru.djvu.online/file/nbMyMYV24nTfs (around printed XLII); it visibly garbles old Cyrillic and does not verify characters or count as independent blind OCR/HTR evidence. This is logically independent in purpose, not in model context.

reviewed_properties.physical_layout: Upper-left XLII, 3 lines initial Greek bibliographic titles, 17 lines Slavic scholarship, 18 numbered archaic Cyrillic items in 20 original printed rows (items 1 and 10 wrapped). No source footnote/signature on this image.
reviewed_properties.witness_type: Printed Ivan Franko text is not an original Syriac/Old Slavic manuscript image. Transcription of old Cyrillic printed source glyphs is a hypothesis.
reviewed_properties.high_risk: Items 1 (possible literal bracket and superscript), 8, 9, 17, 18 (rare characters and potential titla) need specialist image crops and separate blind source reader before verification. Provisional source reader did not encode all possible superscripts faithfully.
reviewed_properties.languages: Two Latin bibliography spans marked, old Cyrillic list language unknown and script Cyrl. No modern Church Slavonic normalization.
